title: Wrong Address
headline: WRONG ADDRESS
synopsis: The PR was written for the fork but posted to gh's default address. Now every envelope is stamped with one repo, and a changed address is returned to sender.
altText: Four panels. Sam hands Kit the fox a letter for the fork. The letter drops into a mailbox labelled UPSTREAM. Kit stamps --repo on every envelope. Glitch the beetle returns a readdressed envelope, stamped RETURN TO SENDER.
layout: four equal panels in a vertical stack, a mailbox recurring in each

panels.scene: Sam hands Kit a sealed envelope marked PR in a tidy post office
Kit drops the envelope into a street mailbox; the mailbox is labelled UPSTREAM and the envelope has no address on it
Kit at a desk stamps the same address on a tall pile of envelopes with a rubber stamp
Glitch the beetle holds up an envelope with a crossed-out address and a big RETURN TO SENDER stamp; Sam and Kit look pleased
